description: Copy one of your Besidka chats, or its start up to and including a message, into a new chat in the same project. The original is not changed. A chat that is generating a reply is refused (a best-effort check). Returns the new chat slug and title. Requires signing in (chats:write).

messageId.description: Message id from get_chat to branch at. Omit to copy the whole chat

name: branch_chat
title: Branch a chat
